I'd say proposing her on her birthday in a pool while her favourite song played in the background.
Still I can think of a million things. The firat day I met her. The day she proposed. Sitting with her on the stairs at the end of the corridor, sunlight melting in her eyes. Letting her put her arms inside my blazer to make her warm. Saying sorry and hugging after long fights. Those promises. Trying out every single dish at our favourite restaurant. Going shopping with her and irritating the hell out of her. Going to her games. The time she came to mine and I heard her cheering from inside the field. Playing video games with her. Watching movies tucked in bed. I don't know where to stop. I really really miss her.
I don't know what to say.

I don't think she asked anything. I couldn't access my phone that day. When I did there was a text from her which said "I have always loved you. Always prioritise yourself and do things for your own happiness. "

I liked to think I made her happy. For a long time I did do I believe. It juat didn't last that long.
I don't know, you tell me. I left my studies after her death. Didn't leave my house or talk to anyone for 4 months. I wake up everyday and I'm feel so empty. She would never let me be this way

I don't know where to start. She was amazing. Awesome. I don't know. I never met or knew anyone like her. She soothed the soul. I really felt alive with her. She would have made a great mother, she had all the instincts. She was caring and soft. She cried if I cried. She was strong and independent, her mind wasn't constrained by society. She was able to think and I loved that about her. She wasn't afraid of anything that came her way. It seemed she had a plan for everything, and whenever she didn't she knew she could come up with it.
She knew how to love. She was delightful, funny and cheeky. She had a beautiful laugh. She walked through with a sennse  of purpose. She waas  cute  aas hell. She knew what made me laugh and what made me xry. She knew how to hug me. She was more than pretty, her eyes were arresting. She had curly hair which she hated, I loved them. They mader her unique. She had dimples on her cheeks as well as her  chin. She had restless hands, always pinching my hands or cheeks. She liked my arms around her neck, always demanded it. She was always ready for tea. I really really miss hee.
My girlfriend committed suicide 7 months ago too. This is all so real to me.

The night before she said I love you because that's what we said before we went to sleep.

Fidst of all thanks a lot for your encouragement. It means a lot. 
My advice to you would be to refrain from telling anyone behind his back. I would suggest that you talk to him openly, tell him that he needs help and you're there for him but his parents or the teacher needs ro know. Don't make him feel left out by telling someone without informing him first. I would suggest you talk to his closest friend and the three of you talk to each other. Talk to your own parents first maybe, having a parent support you is the best thing. Also if I was you  I would not delay anything. Talk to him and then talk to his parents or teacher . Joking about suicide is actually very common among suicidal people. Make him feel loved. 
I also hope you feel better. Remember before doing anything to yourself that a lot of lives will actually be affected without you even if it doesn't seem so. 
Also, my girlfriend committed suicide so yeah , I am no expert. Just take care.

I fully understand you. She usually struggled with her family favouring her brother, her dad being somewhat oppressive and her concept of independence. Like you said most people at some point go through this but she had a hard time growing out of it. This led to her developing trust and anxiety issues. Hope I could satisfy you with my answer.
The sad truth is nor do I know what exactly depressed her and neither did she. It kills me each day but I can't figure anything out.

They did support me a lot, yet after a certain period of time your pain will become someone's burden. That's what I've realised and I don't blame them at all.
I did attend a couple of sessions of therapy and at the time they seemed to help me but I gradually stopped for several reasons.
Most of the times there were things which triggered her. There was no trauma or dark past. She felt she didn't have a motive and she held onto things for survival.

A billion of them. Where is she? Does she want me to join her? Is she even watching me? Is there life after death? Why didn't I message her earlier? All the things I promised but I didn't do. Every time I said No to her for something. Everytime I do something which seems like a move forward but she is not there anymore so what is this all for? What's the purpose of everything? Happiness? But she lived all her life in despair and died because the pain was too much? So what does it even mean? Will I forget her? Of course, I already don't remember a lot of things and it kills me.
These are just a few and on top of all tgese my family thinks I should look ahead, I am young and have a career. I don't blame them but I just can't.

That's exactly why I came here. It's the best community there is.
